name: Gaurav Sen
label: Product Lab
headline: Good products start with better questions.
description: Gaurav Sen’s product management portfolio: AI prototypes, user research, growth strategy and B2B SaaS case studies, with the decisions and evidence behind the work.
about: I’m Gaurav, a project and marketing professional moving deeper into product management. My work spans cross-functional delivery, digital workflows and business strategy. Here, I bring that experience into AI prototypes, product discovery and growth case studies.
aboutSecond: I’m interested in the decisions behind the interface: which problem deserves attention, what evidence changes the direction, and what we should test before scaling. These projects show how I work through those questions.
